results.problem: branching problem (optimal alphabetic binary decision tree with asymmetric taken/untaken branch costs, static or no branch prediction)
results.quote: The optimal tree is thus found through dynamic programming, and this algorithm has O(n^3) time complexity and O(n^2) space complexity, in a similar manner to [21].

results.problem: generalized branching problem with dynamic branch prediction (multiple splitting cost functions C_k)
results.quote: assuming all $C_k$ are calculable in constant time, this can be done in $O(mn^3)$ time and $O(n^2+n\log m)$ space, the $\log m$ term accounting for recalculation and storage of the type of cost function (decision method) used for each branch.
